afnan-supremacy-not-only-intense: Fruity, mossy Aventus-style scent with strong projection; batches vary and some fade within hours.
afnan-turathi-blue: Bright grapefruit that dries musky, strong value for a budget blue; the opening can smell harsh.
ariana-grande-mod-vanilla-eau-de-parfum: Light, clean vanilla that many prefer to Cloud; performance is inconsistent and some find it faint.
armaf-club-de-nuit-iconic: A good-value Bleu de Chanel-style blue, but the opening is often harsh until the bottle rests.
armaf-club-de-nuit-intense-man-eau-de-to: Smoky, fruity dry down; many say the harsh lemon opening smells like a cleaner, though it calms.
armaf-club-de-nuit-sillage: Fresh, metallic citrus in the Silver Mountain Water mould; the opening is often sharp or synthetic.
armaf-club-de-nuit-woman: Many find it very close to Coco Mademoiselle; some say it's not a true match or smells cheap.
armani-acqua-di-gio-eau-de-parfum: Green mandarin and salty notes that suit hot weather; some find it fades in a couple of hours.
armani-acqua-di-gio-elixir: Green, woody violet-leaf take for date nights; longevity ranges from all day to a few hours.
armani-acqua-di-gio-parfum: Lightly smoky and incense-tinged, often compared to Profumo; some bottles fade within hours.
armani-code-parfum: Soft, powdery iris that suits the office all year; projection is modest and it sits close to skin.
armani-stronger-with-you-intensely: Warm vanilla and chestnut for cold weather; a number say it fades and recent batches seem weaker.
azzaro-the-most-wanted-eau-de-parfum-int: Toffee and vanilla that gets compliments, often from women; some find it fades in a few hours.
billie-eilish-eilish-eau-de-parfum: Sweet, warm vanilla gourmand that lasts well on clothes; on some skin it turns medicinal or spicy.
burberry-goddess-eau-de-parfum: Comforting vanilla with lavender and ginger from fall to summer; the opening seems sharp to some.
burberry-hero-eau-de-parfum: Easy woody amber for daily wear, best in cooler months; some find it lacks lasting power.
burberry-hero-parfum: Rich, cedary and long-lasting for fall and winter, seen as more refined; one wearer gets migraines.
calvin-klein-ck-one-eau-de-toilette: Fresh citrus classic for any occasion, good value; light, so a few find it fades or seems generic.
carolina-herrera-good-girl-blush-eau-de-: Creamy floral with fluffy vanilla and almond, often the line favourite; many find it too sweet.
carolina-herrera-good-girl-eau-de-parfum: Sweet jasmine and coffee white floral for date nights; loud for the office, and some get headaches.
chanel-bleu-de-chanel-eau-de-parfum: Refined, safe-for-work all-season scent; the main gripe is staying power, as it sits close to skin.
chanel-bleu-de-chanel-parfum: Richer, smoother and woodier than the EDP and EDT; some find it fades in a couple of hours.
creed-absolu-aventus: Richer, spicier, softer Aventus style for fall and winter; some find it fades and isn't worth it.
creed-aventus: Smoky pineapple for dates and occasions; recent batches often fade to a skin scent, and the price irks.
creed-green-irish-tweed: Fresh, green fougère that is easy in warm weather; it fades fast and recent batches seem weaker.
creed-millesime-imperial: Fresh, salty citrus many call their favourite Creed; the main gripe is that it lasts a couple of hours.
creed-original-vetiver: Clean, soapy citrus-vetiver for work or summer; many say it fades within a few hours.
creed-silver-mountain-water: Crisp, tea-like freshness for warm days and work; it lasts a few hours, which is hard to justify.
dior-homme-eau-de-toilette: Clean, woody daily scent that works across seasons; modest projection, and a few find it boring.
dior-sauvage-eau-de-toilette: Fresh, peppery ambroxan that earns compliments, especially from women; newer bottles fade for some.
dior-sauvage-elixir: Very strong and long-lasting, so a spray or two is enough; several find it overwhelming or headachy.
jean-paul-gaultier-le-beau-le-parfum: Coconut gives a summery, beachy feel and earns compliments from strangers; one finds it cloying.
jo-malone-london-wood-sage-sea-salt: Clean, green and inoffensive, even for the office; many get only a few hours and soft projection.
juliette-has-a-gun-not-a-perfume: Light, skin-like musk that suits the office; so understated that a few smell almost nothing.
kilian-angels-share: Sweet cinnamon and cognac gourmand for cold weather; overspraying brings headaches.
lancome-la-vie-est-belle-eau-de-parfum: Compliment magnet that many wear as a signature scent; sweet and powdery, which some find sickly.
lattafa-eclaire: Creamy vanilla-caramel dessert scent compared to Bianco Latte; the opening can be harsh at first.
lattafa-fakhar-black: Fresh, crisp scent that gets compliments at work; longevity varies, and a couple find it fades fast.
lattafa-khamrah: Boozy cinnamon and apple-pie gourmand with strong projection at a low price; too sweet for some.
lattafa-khamrah-qahwa: Coffee, cinnamon, dates and vanilla that can last days on clothes; some find it too sweet.
lattafa-qaed-al-fursan: Sweet, fruity pineapple that dries woody and is great for the money; many say it fades fast.
le-labo-another-13: Clean, musky skin scent with good staying power; projection varies and some find it metallic.
montblanc-explorer-eau-de-parfum: Affordable Aventus alternative for daily wear; many say it is a skin scent within an hour or so.
mugler-alien-eau-de-parfum: Strong, confident jasmine that earns compliments from strangers; a few find it sour or synthetic.
parfums-de-marly-althair: Sweet vanilla gourmand with cinnamon and a hint of tobacco for dates; some find it too sweet.
parfums-de-marly-delina-exclusif: Soft, creamy rose over vanilla that lasts and projects strongly; a handful get nausea or headaches.
parfums-de-marly-haltane: Warm, spicy praline, leather and soft oud for men and women; too heavy for hot climates.
parfums-de-marly-herod: Warm tobacco and vanilla cold-weather signature; many report it fading within a couple of hours.
parfums-de-marly-layton: Apple, vanilla and spice with strong projection; the main objection is a medicinal menthol opening.
prada-lhomme-eau-de-toilette: Clean, soapy, powdery scent that suits business days; projection is the only gripe.
prada-paradigme-eau-de-parfum: Safe, clean amber and balsam that works almost anywhere; some find it lacks longevity.
tom-ford-black-orchid-eau-de-parfum: Dark, bold evening scent that splits wearers; a fair number find it overwhelming or sickly sweet.
tom-ford-ombre-leather-eau-de-parfum: Potent, very long-lasting leather for cooler weather, often repurchased; a few find it synthetic.
tom-ford-soleil-blanc-eau-de-parfum: Sunscreen-like summer scent that wins over doubters of the range; a few find it nauseating.
valentino-donna-born-in-roma-eau-de-parf: Blackcurrant, jasmine and amber that win compliments from strangers; a couple find the dry down cheap.
versace-dylan-blue-pour-homme-eau-de-toi: Fresh, slightly sweet aquatic that lasts many hours for an EDT; some find it fades quickly in heat.
viktor-rolf-spicebomb-eau-de-toilette: Warm cold-weather scent that draws compliments; a couple find it overpowering or sharp.
